invariants.rationale: The method likely requires min filter to be non-null, as it is passed to texture.setFilter.
The method likely requires mag filter to be non-null, as it is passed to texture.setFilter.
There may be scenarios where the minification and magnification filters are intentionally different.
Order of filter enums may be related, e.g. min filter ordinal less than or equal to mag filter ordinal.
Both parameters should be of the same enum type Texture.TextureFilter.
